title: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker doing odd jobs in New Capenna while searching for home, who has returned from death and fights Maestro enforcers.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker and Elspeth's friend, who works with Karn and the Gatewatch and tells her he found her home, New Capenna (in a flashback).

entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: A vampire Maestro who recruits Elspeth and shows her an angel and Phyrexian sculpture.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: The shadowy Adversary, who learns what the Font is and toasts to taking over the plane.

entities.name: Maestro enforcer leader
entities.description: A dark-haired Maestro enforcer who leads four attackers against Elspeth and shoots sparks from his fingers; unnamed on this page.

entities.name: Launderer shopkeeper
entities.description: Elspeth's unnamed employer, a leonin who is beaten by the Maestro enforcers over a debt.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The god who killed Elspeth and was then imprisoned by Erebos after Elspeth tricked him.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: The God of the Dead who imprisoned Heliod and let Elspeth leave.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: Elspeth's lost love who returned as a man she no longer recognizes.

entities.name: Calix
entities.description: A pursuer who hunts Elspeth.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A member of the Gatewatch who investigates the Phyrexian threat.

entities.name: Bolas
entities.description: A foe Ajani defeated.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: The vampire family with enforcers tied to art and death, whose museum is in Park Heights.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group working with Karn and Ajani against the Phyrexian threat.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: A family with stockpiles of Halo.

entities.name: Brokers
entities.description: One of the five crime families.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: One of the five crime families.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: One of the five crime families.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders whose past incursion on New Capenna is hinted at by the statues of an angel fighting a spined creature.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A domed city of five families where Elspeth seeks home.

entities.name: Mezzio
entities.description: The beating heart of the city and site of the pursuit.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: The upper level home to the Maestros' museum.

entities.name: Caldaia
entities.description: The lower level beneath the half-built bridge.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Elspeth and Ajani met in a flashback.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane Elspeth wanted as her home.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: A magical substance coveted throughout the city.

entities.name: The Font
entities.description: A source of power belonging to the Cabaretti, which the Adversary considers ripe for taking.

entities.name: Crescendo
entities.description: A Cabaretti celebration the Adversary intends to turn into a takeover.

entities.name: Godsend
entities.description: The blade that impaled Elspeth.

events.summary: Elspeth survives by taking odd jobs in New Capenna, still feeling the hollow left by Godsend.
events.quote: She kept her head down and took odd jobs throughout the city as she could find them.

events.summary: A leonin bumps into Elspeth, triggering a memory of her reunion with Ajani on Dominaria.
In the memory, Elspeth tells Ajani how she tricked Heliod into a second confrontation, letting Erebos imprison him.
events.quote: she gave Erebos, God of the Dead, an opportunity to imprison Heliod.

events.summary: Ajani tells Elspeth that home is a feeling, not a place; she bristles and walks away.
events.quote: "Elspeth, home is not a place; it is a feeling.

events.summary: Elspeth hears the shopkeeper being beaten over a debt and intervenes against four Maestro enforcers.
events.quote: "Anyone who finds sadistic pleasure in beating up an unarmed man makes themselves my business."

events.summary: Elspeth leads the Maestro enforcers on a chase through the Mezzio and ends up cornered at a half-built bridge.
events.quote: The road she'd been running down ended abruptly, a half-finished bridge extending out into empty air.

events.summary: Elspeth grabs a steel rod and knocks out all four enforcers without killing them.
events.quote: rendered him unconscious with a thud

events.summary: Anhelo applauds, offers Elspeth work with the Maestros and mentions Halo.
events.quote: Why don't you start with the Maestros?

events.summary: Anhelo shows Elspeth a fountain statue of an angel fighting a spined creature, which Elspeth recognizes as a Phyrexian.
events.quote: Anhelo might not know what it was, but she certainly did.

events.summary: In the memory, Ajani reveals he found her home, New Capenna, and asks her to learn how it survived a past Phyrexian incursion.
events.quote: "There are rumors of a past incursion there, and since New Capenna is still standing, that means they defeated the previous threat."

events.summary: Elspeth planeswalks to New Capenna after Ajani's farewell.
events.quote: She didn't look back as she planeswalked away, headed for what she hoped was home.

events.summary: Elspeth reluctantly accepts the Maestros' offer to gain information on the Phyrexians.
The Adversary, revealed as Ob Nixilis, learns what the Font is and toasts to taking over the plane at the Crescendo.

relations.quote: But you are still my dear friend
settle the score with his old rival

relations.note: works with Karn and the Gatewatch
relations.quote: I came here to meet with Karn and the Gatewatch to discuss the Phyrexian threat.
"The Maestros pride ourselves on knowing New Capenna better than any.

relations.note: her lost love, now a man she does not recognize
relations.quote: How much she had sacrificed for her lost love only to have him return as a man she no longer recognized.
